films.title: Plectis: introduction
films.label: Introduction
films.description: I build tools with AI to make its work easier to understand. This introduction connects the projects’ code, mathematics, explanations and working rules.

films.title: Erdős #257: the reciprocal-summability criterion
films.label: Erdős #257
films.description: The reciprocal-summability criterion for Erdős #257, with the paper and Lean proof. The unrestricted problem remains open.

films.title: CodeMap: reading a codebase
films.label: CodeMap
films.description: Explore project files, their descriptions and connections through architecture, panorama and focus views. I use CodeMap, part of my private system, to investigate changes.

films.title: One Checkout: commit the change you choose
films.label: One Checkout
films.description: Follow a patch from review to Git commit while other agents’ unfinished edits stay in the same working files.

films.title: Plectis mathematics: from proofs to papers
films.label: Mathematics overview
films.description: How work on eight Erdős problems moves from Lean source and long working records to shorter papers and a website for human readers.

films.title: Plectis Atlas: read the sources together
films.label: Plectis Atlas
films.description: Browse OpenAI’s mathematics release by subject, with papers, Lean statements and outside assessments. Authors and reviewers retain credit.

films.title: Safety Core: rules and the checks behind them
films.label: Safety Core
films.description: Follow an editable rule through its folders and guidance to the configured check. The map distinguishes agent guidance from checks that run.

films.title: Plectis: an earlier introduction
films.label: Earlier introduction
films.description: An earlier recording of the introduction, kept as an alternative account of the projects.
